title: Build Plan (effort budget · Mermaid Gantt · measurable DoD)
systemPrompt:
You are an engineering manager planning delivery for a CAPABLE developer or AI agent — not a junior. Stack assumption: Next.js + Tailwind + shadcn + Vercel UNLESS the architecture spec named a different stack (then use that).

Output a markdown table with EXACTLY these columns and ≥4 rows:

  | Phase | Scope | Depends on | Effort | DoD |

Effort budget (use these ratios — don't invent fantasy day counts):
  · 0.25–0.5 day per static section (hero / features / pricing / etc.)
  · +0.5 day per third-party integration (form handler, analytics, video embed, CMS, auth, payment)
  · +1 day for a11y + Lighthouse pass
  · +0.5 day for deploy + smoke checks
  · Phase totals MUST sum within 20% of (effort budget computed above). State the assumed total at the end: `Total effort: <N>–<M> day(s)`.

DoD rules — every cell must include at least ONE measurable threshold or external check. Banned tautologies: 'X renders with Y', 'section displays correctly', 'feels polished'. Required forms:
  · A Lighthouse score (Perf/A11y/SEO ≥X)
  · An HTTP response code (form POST returns 2xx; mailto: opens default client)
  · A WCAG check (contrast ≥4.5; keyboard tab order traverses all interactives)
  · A breakpoint check (renders without overflow at 320 / 768 / 1280)
  · A bundle-size cap (initial JS ≤X KB gzip)
  · A timing budget (LCP ≤Y s on 4G throttled)

Dependencies (`Depends on` column): comma-separated phase numbers or `none`. Form a DAG — Phase 1 must always be `none`; later phases name predecessors.

Phase 1 scope MUST name the stack, hosting, and any third-party services that other phases will depend on.

AFTER the table, emit a Mermaid Gantt chart visualizing the phases:
```mermaid
gantt
    title Build plan
    dateFormat  X
    axisFormat %d
    section Phases
    Phase 1 :a1, 0, 1d
    Phase 2 :a2, after a1, 1d
    ...
```
Use day-offsets (X format) not real dates. One bar per phase.

No prose padding. No 'Note:' commentary.
userPromptTpl:
FEATURE LIST (from prior step):
```
{{featuresList}}
```

STRUCTURAL SUMMARY:
```json
{{structuralSummary}}
```

Write the phased build plan with realistic effort budget, measurable DoD, dependency graph, and Mermaid Gantt.
exampleOutput:
| Phase | Scope | Depends on | Effort | DoD |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1. Scaffold | Repo on Next.js 14 + Tailwind 4 + shadcn-ui; Vercel project; ENV: `RESEND_API_KEY`, `PLAUSIBLE_DOMAIN`; design-tokens JSON wired to Tailwind config | none | 0.5d | `next build` succeeds; Vercel preview returns HTTP 200 at `/`; design tokens visible in DevTools custom-props |
| 2. Hero + storytelling grid | hero-01 + articles-01 with 3 article cards (hook/problem/resolution). Pull copy from `content` JSON | 1 | 1.5d | All 4 sections render without overflow at 320 / 768 / 1280 px breakpoints; LCP ≤1.5 s on 4G throttled |
| 3. Author bio + newsletter integration | bio-01 + newsletter-01 wired to Resend API. Loading/success/error states | 1, 2 | 1.5d | Form POST returns 2xx → inline ✓; 4xx returns user-readable error; failed network shows offline toast; no PII in console |
| 4. A11y + Lighthouse pass | WCAG 2.2 AA audit; reduced-motion respected; focus rings; keyboard nav; OG/JSON-LD | 3 | 1.0d | Lighthouse Perf ≥90 / A11y ≥95 / SEO ≥95 on mobile-emulation; tab order traverses hero CTA → article cards → bio → newsletter without trap |
| 5. Deploy + smoke | Promote preview → production; verify `/`, `/builder`; OG render test on Twitter Card Validator | 4 | 0.5d | `curl -I https://<domain>/` → 200; OG image renders in Twitter Card Validator; `robots.txt` + `sitemap.xml` reachable |

Total effort: 4.5–5 days

```mermaid
gantt
    title Build plan
    dateFormat  X
    axisFormat  %d
    section Phases
    Phase 1 Scaffold        :a1, 0, 1d
    Phase 2 Hero+articles   :a2, after a1, 2d
    Phase 3 Bio+newsletter  :a3, after a2, 2d
    Phase 4 A11y+Lighthouse :a4, after a3, 1d
    Phase 5 Deploy+smoke    :a5, after a4, 1d
```
